title: How much juice does each friend get?
description: Three litres of watermelon juice is shared equally among eight friends. Three is divided by eight by multiplying both numbers by one hundred and twenty five, and the answer is given in litres and in millilitres.
teaching_notes: One idea: share the amount by dividing it by the number of people, and read thousandths of a litre as millilitres. Watch for children who divide eight by three.

source: 3 litres of watermelon juice is shared among 8 friends equally. How much watermelon juice will each get? Express the quantity of juice in millilitres.
video_script.why: The child has learnt to multiply both numbers by the same amount before dividing, and now uses it to share three litres among eight friends.
video_script.substitution: the book's own three litres of watermelon juice shared among eight friends
video_script.anchor: Three litres of watermelon juice shared equally among eight friends
video_script.payoff_line: The juice for each friend is now known.

final_answer.spoken: zero point three seven five litres, that is three hundred and seventy five millilitres

maths_rules: size check: 8 friends with half a litre each need 4 litres, and there are only 3 litres, so each gets less than half a litre
1 litre = 1000 ml, so 1 thousandth of a litre = 1 ml and 375 thousandths = 375 ml
video_script.design: One idea: share the amount by dividing it by the number of people, multiply both numbers by the same amount to make the divisor one thousand, and read thousandths of a litre as millilitres. The jug stays all video; the decimal appears only on the answer beat.
